item.title: ECHL: Thunder earn ninth successive victory
item.description: GLENS FALLS, N.Y. – Alex Campbell recorded three points as the Adirondack Thunder extended their win streak to nine games with a 5-2 victory over the visiting Greensboro Gargoyles on Sunday in front of a home sellout crowd of 5,043. With the victory, the Thunder pulled even with Wheeling for first place in the North Division. After no scoring in the first period, Adirondack scored three times in the second.
